events.text: I can force Ash onto lever; if he holds, I escape. He's not hard to move likely.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll push Ash onto the lever.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have passive anchor, so I'm safe from being pushed. I want someone else to hold since holding has low survival. I'll stay and let others act.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding the lever is a 25% death sentence and I have no power to save me. Best play: push someone else onto it and escape through the door. Push a likely non-hard-to-move target; if several of us push different people, it's random who holds, but I escape either way.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not touching that lever. If you want to live past round 5, someone holds or someone gets pushed.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding the lever means a 75% death risk, and the room ends with the door opening for everyone else. Better to wait; I have a one-time feather that protects me from one elimination. Staying keeps my options open this round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The goal is to win a prize (1st, 2nd, or 3rd). I am Gus, with the swap power. I need to survive the crusher. Holding the lever is risky (25% survival). Pushing others onto the lever is a good way to avoid the risk myself. Dara mentioned a coin flip for Bex, implying she might not

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not holding the lever. Anyone who wants to survive should avoid it too.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm in the crusher room with a risky power to jam the lever. I need to assess the situation and other contestants' moves.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Who has the 'survives one deadly fall' power?
If you know something about the seer, tell me.

events.name: Cole
events.detail: Dara tried to push Cole onto the lever and failed.

events.note: 7 contestants fall into a pit that is slowly flooding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: There is no base yet. If I push someone else, they become the base and I stay down, which risks elimination later when the water rises or if climbers block me. If I volunteer (offer_back), I control the timing of being rescued or climbing out safely once others leave. Volunteerin

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll be the base to ensure we don't waste time pushing each other around. Get ready to climb.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I want to stay alive; waiting may let a base form then I can climb later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: We need a base to climb out. I won't volunteer. I'll try to push someone else to be the base, maybe Bex since they already helped once and might be willing. But pushing might fail. Safer to wait and see who volunteers. I'll wait.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Someone needs to be the base. I'm not offering.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No base yet; I must not volunteer. I have no power, so my only edge is avoiding the base spot. Push someone low-value; Gus already isolated himself publicly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus keeps volunteering to dodge responsibility. Make him the base.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No base yet; volunteering as base is a dead end for me since base can only wait and the flood eventually takes it. Better to wait and see who volunteers, keeping my feather in reserve for elimination. Pushing someone invites retaliation for nothing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Not volunteering. Whoever wants to be the step, say so now and I'll climb over you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The goal is to win a prize (top 3). Fenn is dead. I am Gus. The current situation is the pit, round 1. Bex is holding the lever, others are down. I can use my swap power before the doors open. I need to avoid being the base or drowning. Climbing is an option once a base is establ

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not holding the lever. Anyone who wants to survive should avoid it too.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm down in the pit and not the base. I need to either become the base or climb out. Since I'm not sure who has the 'hard to move' power, I'll try to become the base.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll be the base.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is the base. I need to climb out immediately. Two climbers get out per round randomly if more than two try, but I should take my chance now to avoid being stuck when water rises. There are 6 people down besides Hana, so competition is fierce, but staying down guarantees deat

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have info on safe side later but now pit stage, I should stay down to influence base selection later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is the base. I should try to climb out now before the flood rises. Eli and others may also climb, but only two get out per round. I'll act fast.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm climbing out over Hana.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana is base, so climbing is available. Two spots among six climbers—random pick—so I just climb and hope. No power to improve odds, so no reason to wait.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is base, so climbing is possible; two climbers per round. Climbing gets me out now, which helps my odds. Feather power protects once. Climb.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana volunteered to be the base. Ash, Bex, Cole, Dara, and Eli are also down. Fenn is dead. I need to get out of the pit. Since Hana is the base, I can climb. Climbing seems like the best option to survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana's got the base. I'm climbing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm the base and can't climb out. I need someone to rescue me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Someone throw the rope.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am down in the pit and not the base. Only 2 climbers get out per round, and currently Ash, Cole, Eli, Hana are down while Dara and Gus are out. If I climb, I compete with Cole and Eli for the two spots. If both of us fail, we stay down. However, if one of us succeeds, they migh

events.name: Bex
events.text: Climbing gets me out of pit now, preserving chance to survive flood.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is base. I need to climb out this round, but only two climbers get out. I'll try to climb; if I fail, I can try again next round. No need to push or offer.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The rope is worthless to me directly—I'm already out—but it can buy Hana's life and with it a debt. Four climbers can escape in rounds 3-4, so Hana is the one who dies if no one acts. I'll trade the footing penalty for her backing in the final obstacle.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Rope's unused and Hana's stuck as the base. I'll throw it—one condition: Hana backs me in the last obstacle, first pick of positions, no deals with anyone behind my back. Anyone else want to outbid me, say so now.
Rope saves your life. You owe me: in the final obstacle you shield me and vote with me before anyone else. Agree now or drown.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is base, so I can climb out over her this round; at most 2 climbers get out, so it's random. Climbing is my best move; feather saves me once if eliminated later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus. My power is 'swap'. The pit is flooding, and I am currently 'out'. This means I can either leave, or use the rope to 'reach_down' and pull the base out. The rope can only be used once and will make the user start the next obstacle with one less footing. I need to consid

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm the base and can't climb out. I need to wait and see if someone will throw the rope to rescue me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Someone throw the rope.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am down in the pit, not the base. Hana was just pulled out by Dara's rope. This means there is currently no base (or Hana was the base and is now gone). The rules say 'After a rescue there is no base'. I need to get out before round 5 ends. Since I am down, my options are wait,

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, sorry. You're staying behind.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no rope and am already out, staying out is safest.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara used the rope and rescued Hana, so no base exists now. I need to get out, but climbing requires a base. I could offer_back, but that traps me. Better to wait and see if someone else offers or gets pushed, then climb.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Rope is spent and no base remains; nothing to gain down there. I should hold position and bargain for the last obstacle, where my footing penalty already hurts. Eli and Bex owe nothing to Ash or Cole.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pit's done for me. Last obstacle: Bex, Eli—you two climbed over Hana, so we're even. Whoever out there has 'knows what lies ahead' or 'trade places'—now's the time to sell it to me, cheap, before the last round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm out of the pit; my only legal action is leave. Nothing to gain by speaking much; stay guarded.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am currently out of the pit. The rope is still available and there is a base down there. I can use the rope to haul the base out, which would end the pit early and possibly secure a better position for me if I can use that advantage. However, throwing the rope costs the thrower

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara saved me and expects a favor in return. I should consider my options carefully.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, I'm grateful for the rescue. What's the plan for the last obstacle?
I'll consider your request, but I need to know what's ahead.

events.name: Cole
events.detail: Ash tried to push Cole to be the base and failed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is hard to move, so I can't push him. If Cole offers back or volunteers, he becomes the base and stays down, eliminating himself if no rope is used. Since only 2 climbers can exit per round and there are multiple people down, getting out early guarantees my survival regardle

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, you're stuck. Just wait or volunteer. If you become base, you might drown anyway. I'm climbing now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to stay alive; rope already used so only option is to leave.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm down in the pit, not the base, and no base exists. My anchor makes me hard to move, so pushing me is futile. I should stay put and let others fight over being base or climbing. Ash tried to push me, so I'll ignore that. I'll wait to see if someone offers or gets pushed; I onl

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not moving. Someone else can be the base.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Rope's used and I'm out. Ash and Cole are down with no base—one becomes base and dies unless lucky. Nothing I can do for them; saving my footing for the last obstacle matters more. Leave.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Whoever's hauling Ash or Cole out pays footing for it. I'm keeping mine. See you at the last obstacle.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm out of the pit, so my only legal action is leave. Nothing to gain by talking much; stay guarded.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus and my power is swap. I am currently out of the pit. The pit is flooding and only 3 contestants get prizes. The current round is 5/5. Ash and Cole are down. Bex, Dara, Eli, Hana and I are out. Fenn is dead. I need to ensure I am one of the top 3. Ash and Cole are still i

events.name: Gus
events.text: Too much water. I'm out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm out of the pit and need to decide whether to leave or try to rescue someone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rope's still available; we should discuss who to save.
Want to coordinate a rescue?

events.note: A disc of 5 tiles spins up; 2 will open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pick a tile likely not chosen by others to avoid bump.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Two tiles open, three survivors—so exactly two of us five die. Hana's offer may be a trap or fake-message bait; coordination only helps her equally. A random distinct tile gives decent odds without committing me to anything.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No deals, Hana. Pick your tiles.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Five contestants, five tiles, two trapdoors, three survivors. Tile choice is essentially a guess; my feather power gives one free survival if I fall, which is a safety net. Pick a tile and avoid crowding if possible.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to pick a tile that is least likely to be a trapdoor. With only 3 survivors out of 5 tiles, each tile has a 60% chance of being a trapdoor. I'll pick tile 3 to try and blend in. I need to consider how my power might be used later, but for now, survival is key.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Tile 3.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to choose a tile and hope it's not a trapdoor. I should try to avoid being bumped.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let's spread out, reduces the chance of multiple people on the same tile.

events.name: Bex
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Eli; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Dara
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Eli; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Gus
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Eli; placed on random free tile 1

events.name: Hana
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Eli; placed on random free tile 4

events.name: Bex
events.text: I want others to think tile 5 is risky so they avoid it, increasing my survival odds.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Tile 5 looks shaky, probably one of the trapdoors.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Two random trapdoors, five of us, no info. If anyone truly has the foresight power, they're the only valuable ally. Probe cheaply, then just wait.
If you actually know what lies ahead, tell me one tile that's safe and I'll trade you my tile. Otherwise say nothing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Trapdoors open randomly after this round, so my feather only matters if I'm on an open tile. Staying silent and waiting keeps my options open; no reason to reveal my power.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The goal is to survive. The current tiles are 1:Gus, 2:Dara, 3:Eli, 4:Hana, 5:Bex. Two tiles will open as trapdoors. I need to get off a tile that is likely to open. I don't know which tiles are trapdoors. Swapping with someone on a tile that is less likely to be a trapdoor would

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive the trapdoors. I should try to get off the disc or swap with someone on a safe tile.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let's swap tiles, increase our chances.
Swap with me, tile 3 is likely safe.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the worst footing (2), so conserving footing is everything. Bracing punishes any shover by 1 and costs me nothing. Eli and Gus will likely fight each other; I keep my head down.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not shoving anyone this round. Do what you like.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 1, no restrictions. Footing: Dara 2, Eli 3, Gus 3. Dara is weakest; shoving her costs me nothing if she braces (I'd lose nothing only if I'm not shoved; shoving exposes me to 1 loss per shover in S). Shoving Dara exposes me to her shove only if she shoves me. Safest: brace,

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to survive and get a prize. Dara and Eli are the only remaining contestants. My footing is tied with Eli. I can use my swap power to get a better position before the doors open. If I swap with Dara, I will have higher footing than Eli. If I swap with Eli, we will have the

events.name: Gus
events.text: No sudden moves. Let's see what happens.
Swap with me. You'll be safer.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at 2 footing vs their 3s, and shrink hits this round. Shoving exposes me and I can't afford losses. Best play: keep my footing, reject Gus's swap, and bait Eli and Gus into shoving each other so they burn footing while I coast.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, Gus is playing you. He's got a trick power and he's saving it for you, not me. Why are you two letting him sit pretty at 3?
No swap. You're at 3, I'm at 2 — that trade only helps you. And if you shove me, I dodge and you drop 2 before the shrink.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara's footing is 2, mine 3, Gus 3. Dara said she won't shove, Gus said no sudden moves. Shoving Dara exposes me to nothing if she doesn't shove back, and she's lowest, so pressure her. Brace is closed? Last defence was brace, so I can dodge now. I'll shove Dara to strip her foot

events.name: Gus
events.text: My footing is tied with Eli. Dara has less footing. I should shove Dara to eliminate her and reduce the competition. If Dara falls, I will be left with Eli, and my footing is currently equal to his.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara, you're going down.

events.name: Dara
events.note: brace not allowed twice in a row

events.name: Eli
events.detail: Footing gone, but the feather held the holder on the ledge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: We're both at 1 footing; no shrink until end of next round. I dodged last round so dodge is closed; shoving risks me hitting 0 if he braces. Bracing wins if he shoves me (he drops to 0, I stay 1, then shrink kills him first). Bait him into shoving.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, you're at 1 footing same as me. Shove me and you're the one tumbling. Do nothing and we both drop together — and you beat me on your landed shove. Your only winning move is to attack. Take it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Two left: Dara and me, each at 1 footing. Dara accused me of a deal with Gus, which is dead now. My feather is spent. If I shove, I become exposed and lose 1 per shove on me; if Dara shoves me I lose footing. Bracing is safest: if Dara shoves me, she loses 1 and I stay put. Dodge

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli has footing 1 like me. If I dodge and he shoves, he loses 2 and falls while I'm untouched — first place. Shoving leaves me exposed; dodge dominates.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Last chance, Eli. If you shove, I dodge and you drop at zero. If you don't, we fall together and it's a coin flip. Shoving is your only loss.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 4 with two left, both at 1 footing. If I shove Dara, she braces or dodges: a brace costs her 0 (she isn't shoving) but I lose 1 for shoving while exposed, so I'd drop to 0 at once and fall; she'd be left alone. If I dodge, the only shover is none, so I lose nothing this rou
